invariants.evidence: Capability is added behind the single soil-water solver architecture; no separate SWAP kernel/version is introduced.
No file I/O, parser, unit number or path enters the directional seam.
Directional request/result data is explicitly separate from physical state, forcing, parameters and numerical config.
No derivative/tangent vector is added to persistent per-column physical state.
Captured factorization, RHS and directional vectors remain worker/job scratch.
Contract does not constrain internal storage to per-column heavy objects; scratch remains reusable per worker.
Only an accepted physical step may publish AVAILABLE; retry/nonacceptance publishes no accepted outgoing direction. Multi-step rollback ownership remains F-KT21.
No committed physical origin is modified by sensitivity evaluation; O0/O2 qualification proves physical sensitivity-ON/OFF identity on the admitted fixtures.
Derivative uses generic step_duration; no day/month/year boundary is introduced.
One-step primitive is independent of coupling-window placement or midnight boundaries; whole-window composition remains downstream.
Accepted-step sensitivity is coupling-ready but F-SI37 does not itself claim predictor-corrector, transaction trajectory or whole-window coupling.
No groundwater H/q interface sign or tolerance contract is changed.
Sensitivity cannot relax mass acceptance; mode-5 qbot direction differentiates the exact mass-consistent publication algebra and executable qualification passes.
Accepted-step interface sensitivity is a first-class optional result using the accepted factorization; LOCAL_TERMINAL semantics remain separately named and are not relabelled.
Qualified available path requires zero extra full nonlinear trajectories, zero Jacobian builds and one O(N) tridiagonal backsolve per scalar direction; bounded-cost executable guard passes.
No solver instance or tangent state is stored per logical column; tangent scratch remains worker-owned and compatible with MultiSWAP batching.
No MODFLOW cell/tile mapping assumption is added.
Deep-vadose remains external and unrelated to this solver-side primitive.
No component transition or stored-water transfer semantics are modified.
Alternative soil-water solvers may return sensitivity unavailable without emulating Richards internals; executable alternative-solver fail-closed gate passes.
Directional code differentiates/reuses existing SWAP constitutive and surface-process semantics rather than creating alternate physical values.
HeadCalc arrays do not escape the solver boundary; consumers see only typed directional request/result data.

Physical options are unchanged by sensitivity policy. Nonsmooth physics makes sensitivity unavailable. Switch-specific guards alter only derivative-admission classification, not the qualified value-provider route.
Sensitivity cost is bounded; unavailable routes do not launch repeated production trajectories and the bounded-cost CI guard passes.
Reference Full Richards physical solve remains unchanged and is the qualification oracle target.
Per-step result carries method, route, availability and explicit extra backsolve/Jacobian/nonlinear-solve diagnostics; trajectory diagnostics remain F-KT21 ownership.
Directional work is opt-in; unused solves/columns pay no persistent sensitivity memory cost.
No tile fractions, aquifer mapping or system composition is moved into the SWAP kernel/solver.
Control coordinate, route eligibility, smoothness and unavailable conditions are explicit; no midnight, file-format or MODFLOW assumption is introduced.
Architecture, derivation, cost, fail-closed behavior, physical noninterference and downstream ownership are explicitly audited and the O0/O2 executable owner gate is green.
